Find<Tkey, Tvalue>(Dictionary<Tkey, Tvalue>?, Predicate<Tkey>?)

Searches for a key-value pair in the dictionary using a predicate for the key.

public static KeyValuePair<Tkey, Tvalue> Find<Tkey, Tvalue>(this Dictionary<Tkey, Tvalue>? d, Predicate<Tkey>? predicate) where Tkey : notnull

Parameters

d Dictionary<Tkey, Tvalue>

The dictionary to search in.

predicate Predicate<Tkey>

A function to test each key for a condition.

Returns

KeyValuePair<Tkey, Tvalue>

The first key-value pair whose key matches the predicate, or a default(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>) if no match is found.

Type Parameters

Tkey

The type of keys in the dictionary.

Tvalue

The type of values in the dictionary.

Remarks

This method iterates through the dictionary and returns the first key-value pair where the key satisfies the predicate. If no match is found, returns default(KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>), which typically has a default key and value.

Exceptions

ArgumentNullException

Thrown when d or predicate is null.
